title: Capturing the “RTS” feeling
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5079020/Neverrest/

Working on the first character professions, I really enjoyed the animations of RTS in Warcraft 3 watching your workers collect the node and run back is weirdly satisfying. I am also adding random events that happen every so often with decisions that affect your gameplay for the next 10-15 mins. Next, I am looking into polishing the button art a bit more and adding more juice and adding more “RTS” elements but it’s starting to come along!

All done with Astra I’m liking it alot but the token usage is insane!
